name: Project Summery Report
query:
SELECT 
    ps.project_customer AS "Project Name",
    ps.object AS "Object",
    pa.start_date AS "Start Date",
    pa.end_date AS "End Date",
    ps.project__object_size_in_hecter AS "Total Area (Hectare)",
    pa.total_compleated_work_till_now AS "Completed Area",
CONCAT(ROUND((pa.total_compleated_work_till_now/ps.project__object_size_in_hecter)*100, 2), 2) AS "Completion"
FROM 
    `tabProject Attendance` pa
JOIN 
    `tabProject Setup` ps ON pa.project__client = ps.name
WHERE 
    pa.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY 
    pa.start_date DESC
